page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-tee-8x.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured under the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, powered by Intel Xeon 8469C processors running at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The instance does not utilize hyperthreading, providing a strict 1.0 thread per core allocation. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.0 GB per core.

For acceleration, the instance integrates eight GPUs with a combined total of 768 GB of VRAM. This hardware profile is designed for parallel computing tasks, though it lacks local storage, meaning all storage must be provisioned via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the massive GPU VRAM and system memory capacity, this instance is optimized for heavy parallel processing workloads. The hardware configuration is suitable for large-scale deep learning training, complex AI inference, high-performance computing simulations, and memory-intensive data science tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable compute performance, while the high memory density supports large datasets in memory.
